what_to_detect: An 'at end of combat' trigger (in Forge Mode$ Phase with Phase$ EndCombat, printed or delayed) fires as the end of combat step begins.
near_miss: An 'at end of combat' trigger evaluated at the beginning of a step that does not fire.
record_fields: acting line's script Phase$ (sidecar script text; a delayed trigger's own segment)

what_to_detect: After the end of combat step, a candidate whose targeting needs an attacking or blocking creature has no legal target, because creatures were removed from combat.
near_miss: The same kind of candidate during combat, with attacking or blocking creatures present, has a legal target.
